paite: Ngaihtak in kikou inla, kidam ke'n, pengkul bang in na aw suaksak loloih inla, ka mite kiang ah atatlekna uh hilh inla, Jakob inkuanpihte kiang ah akhelhnate uh hilh in.
heading: An Ngawlna Dik
english: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

paite: Zon zaw niteng in ahon zong zel ua, ka lampi thute theih akilawp ua; diktattak a hih leh a Pathian uh vaihawmna tawpsan ngei lou nam bang in ka kiang ah vaihawmna diktat ahon ngen ua, Pathian naih leng akilawp uhi.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

paite: Bangziak in ahia an ka ngawl ua, na muh louh? Bangziak in ahia ka kihihgentheih ua, na theih louh? achi nak uhi. Ngai un, na an ngawl ni un noumau nopsakna na bawl ua, na nasem mite tengteng na nuaisiah uh.
english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

paite: Ngai un, kihoutheih louh leh kiselna ding leh thulimlouhna khuttum a kitum ding in ahi, an na ngawl nak uh; na aw uh tunglam a zak ding in hiai ni in an na ngawl ngei kei uhi.
english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

paite: Huchibang an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi hia? Mi akihih gentheihna ni ding uh ahi maw? Sialluang bang a alu kun ding leh anuai a sai-ip puan phah a vut buah ding hia? Huaite an ngawlna TOUPA a ding a ni kipahhuai na chi ding ua hia?
english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahweh?

paite: Hiai an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi kei maw? Thulimlouhna a gakna phelsak leh hakkol khaute sutsak leh nuaisiahte pawtsak leh hakkol chiteng hihtansak.
english: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

paite: Na an mi gilkialte kiang a hawm leh genthei delhkhiakte na inn a pi ahi kei maw? Mi vuaktang mu a puan piakleh nangmah tanaute a kipan a kisel louh ahi kei maw?
english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

paite: Huai hun chiang in na vak zing nisuak bang in ahong suak ding a, na damna ding ahong poukhe zok ding; na diktatna in na ma akai ding a; TOUPA thupina na nungdal ahi ding.
english: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and Yahweh’s glory will be your rear guard.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na sam ding a, huchi in TOUPA'N ahon dawng ding; na kikou ding a, huchi in ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi ding. Na lak ua kipan ahakkolte khutzung a mikawkte, mawkpaute na hihman a,
english: Then you will call, and Yahweh will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

paite: gilkialte kiang a na deihlam pia a, hihgentheihmi na taisakleh, na vak mial lak ah avakkhe ding a, na mial bikbek sun lai bang ahita ding.
english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ahon pi gige ding a, mun keu ah leng ahon taisak ding a, na guhte leng ahatsak ding; tui a vak huan bang leh tui nak nei kang ngei lou bang na hita ding hi.
english: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

paite: Huchi in nang a kipan a hong pawt dingte'n mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua; suan tampi suangphum ding in na lemtou nawn ding; huchi in nang bel, ase lai bawlhoihpa, mi omna ding a lampite bawlhoihpa, ahon chi ding uh.
english: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.

paite: "Sabbath tang lou lou ding a, ka ni siangthou a na deihlam hih lou ding a na khepek na ngat kiksak a, Sabbath ni kipahhuai leh TOUPA ni siangthou zahhuai na chih a, nangmah lampi tawn lou a, nangmah nopsakna bawl lou a, nangmah thu gen lou a, na pahtawileh,
heading: Sabbath Tanna Ziak a Kipahman
english: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of Yahweh honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,

paite: TOUPA tung ah na kipak ding a, lei mun sangte ah ka hon tuangsak ding; na pu Jakob gouluah thil in ka hon vak ding," TOUPA kam in huai achita hi.
english: then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.
